Rashi on Nedarim 18a:1:1.hebrew: ותיובתא דרב הונא - דמדקתני עלתה לו שניה בראשונה, מכלל דנזירות שניה נמי חיילא עליה:
Rashi on Nedarim 18a:1:1.english: And [this is] a refutation of Rav Huna - For since it teaches, "the second [term] counts for him toward the first," it follows by implication that the second naziriteship also takes effect upon him.

Rashi on Nedarim 18a:2:1.hebrew: לא לעולם דאמר וכו' ומאי עלתה לו לבר מההוא יומא - למשלים אותו, ושוב מקריב קרבנו, ונמצא נזיר אותו יום שנדר עם ימי נזירות של שלשים יום:
Rashi on Nedarim 18a:2:1.english: No, actually [the case is] where he said, etc., and what [is the meaning of] "is counted for him"? Except for that day - [Meaning,] to complete it, and then he brings his offering; and thus he is a nazirite [on] that day on which he vowed, together with the thirty days of naziriteship.

Rashi on Nedarim 18a:2:2.hebrew: אי נמי - להכי חייב נזירות שניה, כגון שקיבל עליו שתי נזירות בבת אחת, דאמר הרי עלי שתי נזירות — להכי חייב שתים אי לאו שנשאל. אבל אי אמר הריני נזיר היום, הריני נזיר היום, אין נזירות חל על נזירות:
Rashi on Nedarim 18a:2:2.english: Alternatively - For this reason he is obligated [to observe] a second naziriteship: [it is] where he accepted upon himself two [terms of] naziriteship simultaneously, in that he said, "Two [terms of] naziriteship are [incumbent] upon me" — for this reason he would be obligated [in] two, had he not requested [dissolution of the first]. However, if he said, "I am hereby a nazirite today, I am hereby a nazirite today," [one] naziriteship does not take effect upon [another] naziriteship.

Rashi on Nedarim 18a:3:1.hebrew: והלא דין הוא - שלא תהא נזירות חל על נזירות, ולא שאר נדרים נדר על נדר:
Rashi on Nedarim 18a:3:1.english: And is it not an [a fortiori] inference - That naziriteship should not take effect upon naziriteship, nor other vows [take effect], a vow upon a vow.

Rashi on Nedarim 18a:3:2.hebrew: ומה שבועה חמורה - מפרש לקמן, אפ"ה אין שבועה חלה על שבועה:
Rashi on Nedarim 18a:3:2.english: And just as an oath is stringent - [The Gemara] explains below [in what way it is stringent]; even so, an oath does not take effect upon [another] oath.

Rashi on Nedarim 18a:4:1.hebrew: הא קרא בעי - פשיטא ודאי, דהא איכא חד יומא יתירא:
Rashi on Nedarim 18a:4:1.english: Does that require a verse? - [It is] certainly obvious, since there is one extra day.

Rashi on Nedarim 18a:7:1.english: If he requested [dissolution] for the first [oath] - That he came before a sage and asked regarding the first oath, and [the sage] permitted [it].

Rashi on Nedarim 18a:7:2.english: The second [oath] takes effect upon him - For if he transgresses [it], he is liable on account of the second oath.

Rashi on Nedarim 18a:7:3.hebrew: מדלא קתני חייב אחת - דאילו קתני חייב אחת, הוה משמע נמי שעל כולן חייב אחת; וכן אי קתני אינה אלא אחת, הוה משמע נמי שכולן שבועה אחת היא, ואי בצרה לה אזיל ליה חיובא. אלא מדקתני אינו חייב, ש"מ דחיובא חדא מיהא איתיה, דאי נשאל על הראשונה, שניה חלה עליו; דהא דלא חיילא כי לא מיתשיל אראשונה, משום דלית רווחא, דראשונה עומדת דחייב עליה, אבל כשנשאל על הראשונה, חיילא השניה:
Rashi on Nedarim 18a:7:3.english: From [the fact] that it does not teach, "He is liable [for] one" - For if it had taught, "He is liable [for] one," it would also have implied that for all of them [together] he is liable [for only] one; and similarly, if it had taught, "It is only one," it would also have implied that all of them are one oath, and if it is diminished [by dissolving one], the liability goes away. Rather, from [the fact] that it teaches, "He is not liable [except for one]," learn from this that there is at least one liability, such that if he requests [dissolution] for the first [oath], the second takes effect upon him; for the reason that it does not take effect when he does not request [dissolution] for the first is because there is no space [for it], since the first stands [in force] such that he is liable for it — whereas when he requests [dissolution] for the first, the second takes effect.

Rashi on Nedarim 18a:8:1.english: Another version: there is no liability - for the second [oath] in place of the first.

Rashi on Nedarim 18a:8:2.hebrew: הא שבועה איכא - כלומר, שם שבועה עליה לכי מיתשיל אקמייתא:
Rashi on Nedarim 18a:8:2.english: But there is an oath - That is to say, the status of an oath is upon it for when he requests dissolution for the first [oath].

Rashi on Nedarim 18a:8:3.english: With regard to [the statement] of Rava, etc. - (However,) when he requests [dissolution] for the first [oath], the second takes effect.

Tosafot on Nedarim 18a:10:1.hebrew: שקבל עליו ב' נזירות בבת אחת - ק"ק, דהוה מצי לדחויי גם לרב הונא דאמר "היום ומחר": מאי "עלתה לו"? לבר מההוא יומא. אלא הפשוט נקט יותר, ד"עלתה" משמע לגמרי:
Tosafot on Nedarim 18a:10:1.english: "[Where] he accepted upon himself two [terms of] naziriteship simultaneously" - [This is] somewhat difficult, for [the Gemara] could also have deflected [the proof] even according to Rav Huna, who says "today and tomorrow" — [explaining:] what does "it counts for him" mean? Except for that [first] day. Rather, [the Gemara] chose the simpler [explanation], since "it counts" implies completely.

Tosafot on Nedarim 18a:6:1.hebrew: אלא משום דכתיב לא ינקה - כדאמרי' בשבועות (דף לט.), והתם איכא חומרות אחרות, והכא נקט הפשוטות דכתיב בקרא דלא תשא. ואע"ג דלא ינקה בשבועת שקר כתיב, ומתניתין מיירי בשבועת ביטוי — מכל מקום חומרא חשיבותא שוה היא:
Tosafot on Nedarim 18a:6:1.english: Rather, because it is written, "He will not hold guiltless" - As we say in Shevuot (39a), and there, there are other stringencies, while here [the Gemara] cites the straightforward [ones] that are written in the verse of "You shall not take [God's name in vain]." And even though "He will not hold guiltless" is written regarding a false oath, and our Mishnah deals with an oath of utterance, nevertheless, [their] stringency [and] importance are the same.

Tosafot on Nedarim 18a:7:1.hebrew: מדלא קתני אינו אלא אחת - ואע"ג דבכמה מקומות שונה "אינו חייב אלא אחת", אע"ג דליכא אלא חד חיובא — מ"מ, היכא דאיכא למיטעי, לא הוה ליה למתני מתניתין בהאי לישנא:
Tosafot on Nedarim 18a:7:1.english: From [the fact] that it does not teach, "there is only one" - And even though in several places [the Mishnah] teaches, "he is liable for only one," even when there is only one liability, nevertheless, where there is [room] to err, it should not have taught the Mishnah with this wording.

Tosafot on Nedarim 18a:9:1.hebrew: לימא מסייע ליה מי שנדר - והוי מצי לדחויי כשמואל, דאמר דהוי נזיר ב"הריני נזיר היום, הריני נזיר היום"; אלא רוצה שלא תהא הסיוע קיימת אפילו לרב הונא, כיון דמצי לדחויי גם לרב הונא:
Tosafot on Nedarim 18a:9:1.english: "Let us say [that it] supports him: One who vowed" - And [the Gemara] could have rejected [this support] according to Shmuel, who said that he becomes a nazir [for two terms] through [saying] "I am hereby a nazir today, I am hereby a nazir today"; rather, [the Gemara] wants the support not to stand even according to Rav Huna, since it can reject [it] according to Rav Huna as well.
